question: Which team, activity, data and operating/learning scope are being assessed?
Who sponsors this precise scope and owns its risk/release decision?
What review skills have been demonstrated, by whom, and on which tasks?
Where are source checks, sign-off, exceptions, stopping and rollback documented?
Which route, datasets, tool rights and versions are actually approved?
What demand/peaks, complete review time, protected hours, budget, leave/backup and support cover are documented?
Who can stop, log/escalate incidents, accept residual risk and review changes?
What concerns, consultation, adoption support and feedback evidence exist?
Who owns steady-state operation, deputy cover, support, monitoring, changes and retirement?
Which claims are supplied facts, assumptions, current dated records or missing evidence?
